answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, slashed on a failed audit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Reaching the hollow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A garden of per-task receipts records who did what, and the comet of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
